list.title: Listings
list.full: You have reached the limit: withdraw one to add another.
list.emptyBody: A listing says what you do and where. After you send it, a moderator checks it and then it appears in the directory.
list.liveWithEdit: Live. An edit has been waiting for review since {date}.
list.pendingSince: Sent for review on {date}. Not public yet.
list.suspendedMeta: Suspended by EventDesk. Open it to see the reason.
list.rejectedMeta: The last submission was not approved. Open it to see the reason.

new.title: New listing
new.description: Choose from the lists what you do and where. Nothing becomes public until a moderator approves the listing.

blocked.restricted: The business is restricted or suspended: no listings can be added.
blocked.lapsed: You cannot add new listings right now. Existing ones stay live and can be corrected.
blocked.full: You already have {max} listings. Withdraw one to add another.

editor.fixErrors: A few things still need fixing. You will find them beside their fields.
editor.nameHint: The name shown in the directory.
editor.categoriesHint: Choose between one and five categories.
editor.whereHint: Add up to five counties, then tick the localities in each — twenty at most in total.
editor.descriptionRoHint: At least a few sentences: what you offer, for what kind of events, what sets you apart. No promises you cannot keep.
editor.descriptionEnHint: If it is missing, visitors reading in English see the Romanian text, marked “Romanian only”.
editor.contactHint: They appear on the listing page, for anyone. Fill in only what you want to be public.
editor.photoHint: PNG or JPG, 10 MiB at most. Only photos that are yours.
editor.photosAfterSave: You can add photos after you save the draft.

saved.draft: The draft has been saved. Nothing public has changed.
saved.submitted: The listing has been sent for review.
saved.submittedBody: A moderator will check it. Until then the public version stays as it is.

detail.title: Listing
detail.notLiveYet: Nothing yet: the listing has not been approved.
detail.pendingEditBody: Sent on {date}. The public version stays unchanged until the moderator decides.
detail.pendingNewBody: Sent on {date}. The listing becomes public once approved.
detail.pendingNoChange: No difference from the public version.
detail.editBody: Every change goes to a moderator again. Until then the version above stays public.
detail.draftNotice: You have a saved draft that has not been sent yet.

rejected.title: The last submission was not approved
rejected.next: Your text is kept below. Fix it and send it again.

suspended.title: The listing is suspended
suspended.body: It does not appear in the directory and cannot be changed until the suspension is lifted.

stats.title: Response statistics
stats.body: After ten enquiries you have answered, the listing page shows how often and how quickly you reply. They are computed daily and cannot be bought or edited. You can hide them.
stats.notYet: They do not appear yet: not enough answered enquiries.

retire.title: Withdraw the listing
retire.body: The listing leaves the directory and frees one of the five places. It cannot be brought back.
retire.confirmBody: The public page disappears at once. If you only want to change something, edit the listing instead of withdrawing it.

errors.unknownField: The form contains an unknown field. Categories and localities can only be chosen from the lists.
errors.unknownCategory: One of the categories is not on the list. Choose from those shown.
errors.unknownCounty: One of the counties is not on the list. Choose from those shown.
errors.unknownLocality: One of the localities is not on the list. Choose from those shown.
errors.localityOutsideCounties: A locality is not in the chosen counties.
errors.countyWithoutLocality: Tick at least one locality in each county you added, or remove the county.
errors.descriptionTooShort: Write at least a few sentences (20 characters minimum).
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, for example 0722 123 456.
errors.websiteHttps: Enter the full address, starting with https://
errors.tooManyPhotos: You can add eight photos at most.
errors.photoNotYours: One of the photos is no longer available. Remove it and upload it again.
errors.tooManyListings: You already have {max} listings. Withdraw one to add another.
errors.nothingToSubmit: There is nothing to send. Fill in the listing first.
errors.retired: The listing has been withdrawn and can no longer be changed.
errors.suspended: The listing is suspended and cannot be changed until the suspension is lifted.
